common_support.source: Researcher labels unchanged; pixel-center package index reused; no pixel-level classifier; fixed training-only scaling; correction coefficients for eligible/robust/stabilized exclude all evaluation polygons+2m. Historical/current scene fits are transductive diagnostic baselines.

final_decisions.1. Numerically consistent candidate refl: Yes, conditional on DN/32768. Ten-band affine conversion/masks and precision verified; calibration not verified.
final_decisions.2. Scale-invariant SCS+C?: Yes at the tested scales and masks; C and factors unchanged. An absolute near-zero-slope tolerance can break invariance in other regimes.
final_decisions.3. Cause of historical extremes?: Negative fitted C cancels positive illumination near the .001 guard. Uncertain/confounded regression, not the common radiometric multiplier.
final_decisions.4. Preventable instability?: Resolved-domain/uncertainty exclusions prevent these near-pole outputs without clipping; better fitting/Huber alone does not.
final_decisions.5. Less illumination dependence?: Yes descriptively, with weak negative residual red correlation; not independent physical validation.
final_decisions.6. Spectral relationships preserved?: Not uniformly: band-dependent factors alter shape; no absolute reference certifies improvement.
final_decisions.7. Better within-polygon consistency?: Not overall: lower absolute variance, but higher CV and spectral angle.
final_decisions.8. Better PFT separability?: Mixed class-pair effects; no general or independently validated gain.
final_decisions.9. Better PFT identification?: No established gain on matched support; stabilized65.2%versus raw68.3%, paired interval spans zero.
final_decisions.10. Experimental use?: Yes for explicitly conditional diagnostic sensitivity analysis; raw remains primary for ecological interpretation.
final_decisions.11. Production readiness?: No. Verify calibration, timing/terrain/shadows and North/contributor provenance; independent targets and spatial/site-held-out evaluation are needed.

recommendation: Keep raw candidate reflectance primary. Stabilized branch is a resolved-support sensitivity diagnostic, without established PFT/physical accuracy gain. No production change.
